per_query_results.query: What is total revenue per product category?
per_query_results.ground_truth: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) as revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category
per_query_results.generated: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) as revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category LIMIT 100
